Q: Different sys.path when another user A:

Since the virtual environment was created by root user, other user won't be able to read the directory <VENV_PATH>/.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages.

The dirty solution I found was to manually edit the permission of each directory and file:

find <VENV_PATH> -exec chmod o+rx {} \;

Q: Recommended structure for multi Products and Customers A:

For a scenario like this, a recommended approach is to structure your Azure DevOps organization around multiple teams, projects, and security boundaries to ensure appropriate visibility and access control.

You can create a single Azure DevOps project with multiple teams—one per customer or per product, depending on your granularity needs. Assign each customer team permissions to only see work items related to their products, which can be achieved using area paths and security permissions. Developers, on the other hand, should have access to all work items across teams and repositories.

Regarding repositories, organize them by product and create branch policies to manage development workflows per customer or product. Use area paths to categorize work items by customer and product, enabling stakeholders to filter and view their relevant backlog items easily.

For detailed guidance and best practices on structuring Azure DevOps projects, teams, and security, see my article: ADO Project Structure

Q: How to fix Error executing process Utility 'pg_restore' not found in client home '/usr/lib' (/usr/lib)? A:

That indicates that you got strange permissions set on the /usr directory. Allow the user that started DBeaver "read" and "execute" on that directory.

On correctly installed Linux machines, the permissions should be set like this:

> ls -ld /usr
drwxr-xr-x. 39 root root 4096 Jan 11 10:28 /usr

You can set them like that with

chmod 0755 /usr

Q: Increasing tomcat keep-alive timeout A:

There are server.xml files in multiple directories. There are 2 directories. One with configurable templates (/hybris/config/tomcat/conf), that are enriched with configuration parameters and then put to the tomcat directory (/hybris/bin/platform/tomcat/conf) for use during the ant all or ant server process.

If you make changes to the version in the platform directory, they will be overwritten during ant all or ant server. Make sure to change the server.xml in the config directory.

Q: powershell CategoryInfo NotSpecified and newlines A:

I stumbled across such an example as well a few months ago. The problem actually is that somehow (Windows) Powershell did treat the stderr as a string to interpret. I still don't understand how to suppress this properly.

I made it shut up by redirecting stderr to NULL:

command -p1 -p2 ... 2>$nul

Try whether redirecting to NULL suppresses the error - if that may be an option. You still can query for $LastExitCode.
